senses.gloss: f. (לוּן I) leaving over night, undue delay over night.
units: <cite ref="Meilah 4b:6">Meïl. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ דקעביד בידים</he> the illegal delay of the sprinkling of the blood, an offence which he commits with his hands (omission of an act), opp. to <cite ref="M00944"><he>מחשבה</he></cite> undue thought.—<he>הֲלָנַת דין</he> the reserving of the verdict for the next morning.
